Widget Levy Act, Chapter 2: Registration.

Section 4. Every supplier of widgets shall apply for registration within thirty days
from the date on which the supplier first becomes liable to registration.

Section 5. A supplier becomes liable to registration when the aggregate value of widget
supplies in a financial year exceeds the registration threshold of ninety-nine units.

Section 6. A registered supplier shall display the registration number at the principal
place of business and on every invoice issued.
